name: Bakers' Ginger Snaps
description: Historical recipe from The Whitehouse Cookbook (1887). Source method; not modernized or kitchen-tested.

ingredients.name: shortening, part butter
ingredients.originalText: one cup of shortening, part butter

instructions.text: Boil all together the brown sugar, molasses, shortening, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves
Remove from the fire and let it cool
Sift four cups of flour and stir part of it into the mixture
Dissolve a teaspoonful of soda in a tablespoonful of warm water and beat into the mixture
Stir in the remainder of the flour and make stiff enough to roll
Roll into long rolls about an inch in diameter and cut into half-inch pieces
Place them on well-buttered tins, giving plenty of room to spread
Let them cool before taking out of the tins

source.author: F.L. Gillette
source.originalInstructions:
1. Boil all together the brown sugar, molasses, shortening, ginger, cinnamon, and cloves
2. Remove from the fire and let it cool
3. Sift four cups of flour and stir part of it into the mixture
4. Dissolve a teaspoonful of soda in a tablespoonful of warm water and beat into the mixture
5. Stir in the remainder of the flour and make stiff enough to roll
6. Roll into long rolls about an inch in diameter and cut into half-inch pieces
7. Place them on well-buttered tins, giving plenty of room to spread
8. Bake in a moderate oven
9. Let them cool before taking out of the tins
